source.title: 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol.4, Ch.5 Cropland
source.locator: Table 5.12 (UPDATED), disaggregated column, row 'Multiple drainage periods' (footnote b: includes alternate wetting and drying)

entries.scope: Irrigated rice under multiple drainage periods including AWD; IPCC Tier 1 default method as used by the AgriCarbon Carbon Engine. Not a country-specific (QĐ 2626 / QĐ 4801) factor.
entries.rationale: The scaling factor this pointer resolves to is greater than zero, so the method models AWD as a reduction of field methane, not as its end. A statement that AWD (for one season or otherwise) ends methane emission contradicts it.

verification.note: The YAML's status VERIFIED is the project's own citation check; methodology.domain_expert_review is PENDING; no artifact hash or evidence file of the IPCC PDF is recorded here. NOT independently verified.

source.title: AgriCarbon deterministic recommendation rules, R3 data completeness
source.locator: backend/recommendation/rules.py: DATA_TASK_RULE_CODE + '.water' (rule_version 1) emits a water data task whenever a season lacks water data

entries.scope: Every season assessed by AgriCarbon: water use is an input of the carbon estimate, so water records stay required after adopting AWD.
entries.rationale: AgriCarbon's own product rule requires water data for every season. This is project policy, not an external agricultural or MRV authority; an expert must confirm it against the MRV procedure before it is cited as such.

verification.note: Internal rule. The QĐ 4801/QĐ-BNNMT MRV annex is not available to the project, so no external source is claimed.
